id: # Starter rows for a PHP repo. Add runner=<repo path> when PHP runs in a container. Driver keys: vault/architecture/qg-builtin-drivers.md in vault-quality-gates.

why: a commit may not add a PHPStan error, so type errors never reach main
a commit may not add code Pint would reformat, so the style never drifts
a commit may not add a PHPMD violation to the files it changes
the test suite passes on every pushed commit
a merge-conflict marker left in a file breaks it for every reader
the gate configuration is changed by a human only, so an agent cannot loosen the gate that judges it
